description: Why canonical-with-proper-tower does not reproduce: the E_0 calibration evaluates Φ_q at 95.91% of its pole, below the cap_frac=0.98 clamp, which therefore never fires. Φ_q = 7.81e6 vs the ~3.85 implied; 0.188% in V̂ -> 9.06% in Φ_q (48×). scope-(a). bean qou-0gqn.

result.verdict: MEASURED (scope-(a)): `canonical-with-proper-tower.witness.json` does not reproduce because its E_0 calibration evaluates Φ_q at 95.91 % of the pole, inside the band `cap_frac=0.98` declares safe, so the clamp never fires. Φ_q = 7.81e6 there against the ~3.85 the witness implies, and the point is ill-conditioned: a 0.188 % change in V̂ moves Φ_q by 9.06 %, a 48× amplification that E_0 = M_P/Φ_q inherits whole. The term split of 8cf5569648 is NOT the cause — the calibration is deliberately pinned to the historical `phi_q` — and neither current term reproduces June at today's V̂, so the V̂ moved too. This does NOT say which numbers are right, that the tower formula is wrong, or which commit moved V̂; that bisect is not done.

excluded_causes: 8cf5569648 term split — the calibration is deliberately pinned to term='phi_q', the historical form
full vs adjacent now identical — correct, A=1 has no pairs
not_established: which set of numbers is right
that the tower formula is wrong
which commit moved V̂ (bisect not done)

assertions.name: cap_does_not_fire_at_the_calibration_point
assertions.source: phi_q_safe clamps to cap_frac*q; the proton's larger V̂ is BELOW that cap, so the clamp is inert and Φ_q is evaluated at 95.91% of its singularity

assertions.name: phi_q_at_the_calibration_point_is_enormous
assertions.source: Φ_q summed over the proton's two generators exceeds 1e6, against the ~3.85 the June witness implies

assertions.name: calibration_is_ill_conditioned
assertions.source: a 0.188% change in V̂ moves Φ_q by 9.06%, so E_0 = M_P/Φ_q amplifies its input's relative error by 48×; computed in mpmath, not through the float64 function under test

assertions.name: the_cap_does_not_regularise
assertions.source: across the whole band the cap declares safe, Φ_q spans a factor ~300 — the cap bounds the blow-up, it does not remove it, and its bound is still 7 orders above the June total

assertions.name: neither_current_term_reproduces_june
assertions.source: tower_term gives E_0 = 649.44 and phi_q gives 6.79e-5; neither is June's 243.53. Reaching it through Φ_q would need V̂ = 0.1432 (12.9% of q), 7.4× smaller than today's 1.0646 — so the V̂ moved as well as the term
